svg.text: Shared AWS / host collection and workload-specific delivery paths into Elastic.
AdversaryLabAI · Implementation: e639b49 · 26 Nov 2026 · Architecture view; validation limits are in the walkthrough.

Teal dashed lines represent telemetry delivery. The EC2 collector also collects endpoint activity and system data. SSM capture, MCP client publication and native-audit delivery have the configuration and
validation limits described in the walkthrough.
